The drivers specify multiple USB IDs for this device.. *07cc:000a (in WLANMON.INF) **'''<small>WLAN USB Firmware Loader</small>''' *07cc:000b (in WLANUSB.INF) **'''<small>GeoWave/US110 Adapter</small>'''
The driver files indicate that this device was manufactured by Z-Com. :The same OEM product may have also been released by '''Kingston''' as the [[Kingston KNW-USB11|KNW-USB11]] (but if it was it is extremely rare).
This entry has been filled assuming that the PCMCIA slot of the device has been occupied by a compatible wireless module ([[Planex GW-NS110]] or [[Planex GW-NS110PX]]). The assumed FCC ID of the GW-NS110 has been assigned to this device.
